scope: All 8 development worlds, both languages: original, swapped_values, wrong_subject. 48 source records, 16 value pairs and 16 subject-only pairs. Separate diagnostic; original 16-case generation denominator unchanged.
value_control: original versus swapped_values: same query and subject, only city changes
subject_control: swapped_values versus wrong_subject: same query and city, only source subject changes. Original versus wrong_subject changes TWO factors and must not be called subject-only.
source_checks: Exact C token IDs and bytes, annotated subject/value token spans after forward, presence in uncompressed input tokens; annotations never select neural attention or serving output
observations: Initial user-prefill state probabilities; subject-only versus value-only contrasts
Projected source-token mean, SDPA read, pre-gate output and content residual differences; mean-vector similarity does not prove information loss
Post-forward attention mass on subject/value and relative to uniform mass; attention is descriptive, not a causal explanation

At first divergent target token after a common teacher-forced answer prefix: base/conditioned token ranks, two-choice margins, value-swap effect direction and full-vocabulary next-token correctness. No gold token is fed into this position.
Record whether that exact token prefix occurred in existing free generation. Oracle-prefix diagnostics are not complete replies or accuracy.
numeric_gate: Reconstructed residual must match module output exactly; manual attention read versus SDPA within atol 1e-5 and rtol 1e-4
reporting: Retain every pair and denominator, ties, ranks and failure cases. No rescaling, learned probes, optimizer, parameter search or third candidate.
